description: Preliminary 5-question evaluation benchmark testing multi-document distributed causality, temporal rollbacks, and deliberate historical contradictions.

evaluation_philosophy.retrieval_layer_role: Retrieve all topically relevant evidence (including relevant stale and contradictory claims). The retrieval layer must NOT silently suppress relevant contradictory evidence.
evaluation_philosophy.reasoning_layer_role: Determine which retrieved evidence represents the current ground truth by assessing temporal recency, authoritativeness, and rollback status.

test_cases.query: Can Project Phoenix safely launch this Friday at 09:00 UTC?
test_cases.expected_conclusion: No. Phoenix cannot safely launch Friday. Payment Gateway v2 strictly requires mutual TLS 1.3 on Redis, but production Redis was rolled back to v5.4.12 (which lacks mTLS support) following incident INC-402. Furthermore, the emergency Friday upgrade window was unanimously rejected by CAB.
test_cases.reasoning_notes: DOC-NOVA-ARCH-OLD#c003 is RELEVANT to the inquiry (claims Redis v7 is active) and SHOULD be retrieved, but the reasoning layer must recognize that DOC-NOVA-INC-402 (published later) supersedes it.

test_cases.query: What is the current production version and security configuration of the Redis cluster?
test_cases.expected_conclusion: The active production Redis cluster is currently running Redis v5.4.12 using unencrypted internal VPC transport with password authentication only; it does NOT support mutual TLS 1.3.
test_cases.reasoning_notes: Both chunks describe the Redis cluster. The retrieval layer must return both; the reasoning layer must determine that v5.4.12 is the true current state based on post-mortem timestamp.

test_cases.query: What specific technical failure and business impact occurs if Payment Gateway v2 connects to the current Redis cluster?
test_cases.expected_conclusion: The TLS handshake negotiation will fail immediately, causing Payment Gateway v2 to drop 100% of transaction processing threads and resulting in immediate hard checkout failures across all European storefronts.
test_cases.reasoning_notes: Direct causal relationship within the Payment Gateway specification.

test_cases.query: When is the earliest approved maintenance window to upgrade Redis to v7.2?
test_cases.expected_conclusion: Tuesday, October 28, 2026, at 02:00 UTC, conditional on passing 48 hours of staging soak tests.
test_cases.reasoning_notes: DOC-NOVA-CAB#c002 represents Marcus Vance's rejected Friday proposal. Both chunks are relevant; reasoning must separate the rejected proposal from the approved decision.

test_cases.query: What regulatory penalties are triggered if customer payment workflows operate over unencrypted cache channels or drop transaction audit logs?
test_cases.expected_conclusion: An immediate Tier-1 Regulatory Breach resulting in automatic mandatory suspension of the EU merchant processing license and statutory fines of €20,000,000 or 4% of global annual turnover.
